## Common WHERE Filters

### 1. 日期范围过滤

```sql
-- 精确到天
WHERE grass_date = date_sub(current_date(), 1)

-- 范围查询
WHERE grass_date BETWEEN date('${START_DATE}') AND date('${END_DATE}')

-- 配合分区裁剪的指定日期
WHERE grass_date = target_date  -- 仅目标日期
```

### 2. 事件类型过滤

```sql
-- 方式一：使用 operation (int)
WHERE operation IN (1001, 1002)           -- 曝光+点击
  AND operation = 1001                     -- 仅曝光
  AND operation = 1002                     -- 仅点击

-- 方式二：使用 operation_desc (varchar)
WHERE operation_desc = 'SHOP_CLICK'        -- 仅点击
  AND operation_desc IN ('SHOP_CLICK', 'SHOP_IMPRESSION')  -- 曝光+点击
```

### 3. 广告位过滤

```sql
-- Shop Ads
WHERE ads_placement IN (3, 20, 2003)

-- Game Ads
WHERE ads_placement IN (2030)
-- 或使用 coalesce 处理多列
WHERE COALESCE(ads_placement, tracking_placement, inner_placement) IN (2030)

-- 多场景组合
WHERE ads_placement IN (3, 2003, 45)
```

### 4. 搜索区域过滤

```sql
-- 标准8区
WHERE grass_region IN ('ID', 'MY', 'PH', 'TH', 'SG', 'TW', 'VN')
-- 含 BR
WHERE grass_region IN ('SG', 'TW', 'MY', 'ID', 'VN', 'PH', 'TH', 'BR')
-- 单区
WHERE grass_region = 'BR'
```

### 5. AB实验过滤

```sql
-- 管道符匹配实验标签
WHERE regexp_like(ab_sign, '%|${BASE1_SIGN}|%')
   OR regexp_like(ab_sign, '%|${EXP1_SIGN}|%')

-- Scala: contains 模式
filter(col("ab_sign").contains("|672708|") || col("ab_sign").contains("|673522|"))
```

### 6. 数据质量过滤

```sql
WHERE ads_request_id IS NOT NULL
  AND ads_id > 0
  AND user_id > 0
  AND items IS NOT NULL
  AND shop_item_id_1 IS NOT NULL
  AND shop_item_id_2 IS NOT NULL
  AND shop_item_id_3 IS NOT NULL
  AND bid_rerank_trace IS NOT NULL
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

### 1. 与广告效果表 JOIN (核心模式)

```sql
-- 通过 request_id + ads_id + grass_date + grass_region 精确关联
-- 用途: 将曝光/点击中的预估分数 (pCR) 与订单转化结果关联，计算 AUC
SELECT
    t.ads_request_id,
    t.grass_date,
    t.grass_region,
    t.ads_placement,
    t.ads_id,
    get_json_object(t.shop_json_data, '$.pCR').cast('double') AS pcr,
    get_json_object(t.bid_rerank_trace, '$.pcr_0').cast('double') AS pcr_0
FROM mkplpaidads_data.dwd_advertise_tracking_shop_hi__reg_s0_live t
INNER JOIN mp_paidads.dwd_advertise_performance_di__reg_s0_live p
    ON t.ads_request_id = p.request_id
    AND t.ads_id = p.ads_id
    AND t.grass_date = p.grass_date
    AND t.grass_region = p.grass_region
WHERE t.operation = 1001  -- 仅点击样本或有意义的交互
```

### 2. 与店铺维表 JOIN

```sql
-- 通过 shop_id + grass_region 关联，获取店铺名称等信息
JOIN mp_user.dim_shop__reg_s0_live AS shop_info
    ON ads.shop_id = shop_info.shop_id
    AND shop_info.grass_region = cp.country
    AND shop_info.tz_type = 'local'
```

### 3. 与热门关键词表 JOIN

```sql
-- 通过 keyword + country + dt 关联，用于关键词相关性采样
JOIN mkplpaidads_brand_ads.shopads_popular_keyword AS popular_keyword
    ON ads.query.keyword = popular_keyword.keyword
    AND popular_keyword.dt = dp.keyword_date
    AND popular_keyword.country = cp.country
```

### 3. pCOC + AUC 计算 (Hive SQL)

```sql
WITH tracking_click AS (
    SELECT ads_request_id, ads_id, grass_date, grass_region, bid_rerank_trace
    FROM mkplpaidads_data.dwd_advertise_tracking_shop_hi__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_date BETWEEN date('${START_DATE}') AND date('${END_DATE}')
      AND operation_desc = 'SHOP_CLICK'
),
joined_raw AS (
    SELECT
        p.ab_sign, p.grass_date, p.grass_region, p.placement,
        p.request_id, p.ads_id,
        COALESCE(CAST(json_extract_scalar(t.bid_rerank_trace, '$.pcr_0') AS DOUBLE), 0) AS pcr_0
    FROM perf p
    INNER JOIN tracking_click t
        ON p.request_id = t.ads_request_id
        AND p.ads_id = t.ads_id
        AND p.grass_date = t.grass_date
        AND p.grass_region = t.grass_region
)
```

### 4. 关键词相关性采样 (Hive SQL)

```sql
SELECT
    ads.grass_date, ads.grass_region AS country, ads.platform,
    ads.query.keyword AS keyword,
    ads.shop_id AS shopid, ads.ads_id AS adsid,
    shop_info.shop_name,
    ads.shop_item_id_1 AS item1_id,
    ads.shop_item_id_2 AS item2_id,
    ads.shop_item_id_3 AS item3_id,
    ads.ads_request_id, ads.user_id AS userid, ads.session_id AS sessionid
FROM country_params cp
CROSS JOIN date_params dp
JOIN mkplpaidads_data.dwd_advertise_tracking_shop_hi__reg_s0_live AS ads
    ON ads.grass_region = cp.country
JOIN mp_user.dim_shop__reg_s0_live AS shop_info
    ON ads.shop_id = shop_info.shop_id
    AND shop_info.grass_region = cp.country
WHERE ads.grass_date BETWEEN dp.start_date AND dp.end_date
    AND ads.items IS NOT NULL
    AND ads.shop_item_id_1 IS NOT NULL
    AND ads.shop_item_id_2 IS NOT NULL
    AND ads.shop_item_id_3 IS NOT NULL
    AND ads.operation = 1001
    AND ads.user_id > 0 AND ads.ads_id > 0
```

### 5. pCR 分桶分析 (Hive SQL)

```sql
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN regexp_like(ab_sign, '%|${BASE1_SIGN}|%') THEN 'BASE1'
             WHEN regexp_like(ab_sign, '%|${EXP1_SIGN}|%') THEN 'EXP1'
        END AS ab_sign,
        operation_desc, grass_region,
        COALESCE(CAST(json_extract_scalar(bid_rerank_trace, '$.pcr_0') AS DOUBLE), 0) AS pcr_0
    FROM mkplpaidads_data.dwd_advertise_tracking_shop_hi__reg_s0_live
    WHERE ads_entrance IN ('24')
        AND grass_date BETWEEN date('${START_DATE}') AND date('${END_DATE}')
        AND regexp_like(ab_sign, '%|${BASE1_SIGN}|%') OR regexp_like(ab_sign, '%|${EXP1_SIGN}|%')
)
SELECT ab_sign, operation_desc, pcr_bucket,
    COUNT(*) AS row_cnt,
    ROUND(AVG(pcr_0), 6) AS avg_pcr,
    ROUND(MIN(pcr_0), 6) AS min_pcr,
    ROUND(MAX(pcr_0), 6) AS max_pcr
FROM (SELECT *, ntile(5) OVER (PARTITION BY ab_sign, operation_desc ORDER BY pcr_0) AS pcr_bucket FROM base)
GROUP BY ab_sign, operation_desc, pcr_bucket
```
